_provenance.source: GitLab MCP server tool reference — zereight/gitlab-mcp (83 tools; merge_request write ops create_/merge_/update_merge_request re-verified against the vendor tool list at implement time 2026-07-06). accept_/rebase_merge_request enumerated defensively as real GitLab REST ops (PUT …/merge, PUT …/rebase) that other/older MCP servers wrap; harmless-if-absent under the anchored matcher.
_provenance.note: D9 schema-derived, NOT live-captured (no GitLab MCP server configured on this machine). NOTE the real zereight tools key on project_id (namespace/path), NOT owner/repo — a project_id-only write hits the gate’s unextractable-owner/repo fail-CLOSED deny (also DENY). These write fixtures carry owner/repo to exercise the per-tool mcp_deny_reason branches (the server-schema axis that DOES carry owner/repo).
